Andrew, saw ASI acquired CSI's suite to launch the iMIS Power Suite and landed on G2's 2026 Best Software list.

Folding in an acquisition usually means more enterprise associations in play than reps can cover while the portfolio expands, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for ASI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Andrew, quick follow-up for ASI.

With the Power Suite to cross-sell, the enterprise number tends to climb faster than headcount can, and most sales orgs cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit it. The gap surfaces late, when saving the quarter is already a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your enterprise team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for ASI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how ASI's reply rate likely compares to other established association-software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
